name: krishnaos
description: KrishnaOS — a macOS-inspired personal portfolio, disguised as an operating system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/client" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/client && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/client && npm run typecheck -w apps/server
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist
